architecture.mechanism: tunable heat reservoir control via tailored drive sequences
architecture.intervention: Implement a flux-ramp analog in the engine control unit to modulate fuel injector pulse width and ignition timing during warm-start cycles, interleaving cooling (lean) and heating (rich) phases to stabilize thermal reservoir conditions before firing.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of extended cranking and rough idle by precisely managing the engine's thermal state during the start sequence, preventing fuel odor and starter grinding.
architecture.falsification_test: Duplicate the warm-start fault on a 2020 Toyota Tacoma TRD Off Road with the modified control logic; if extended cranking (>3 seconds) or rough idle persists after 50 cycles, the mechanism is falsified.
